title: /g/personal/ sharing token link on a -my host: Unresolved, personal site path and owner hint (BC-011, BC-014)

method.text: Recognised a sharing token link (/g/ variant, Excel workbook) on the personal site of user_contoso_onmicrosoft_com. The token cannot be decoded without signing in, so the path, library and folder are unknown. Authenticated validation can resolve it.

hints.label: item type from the link prefix ":x:"
owner sign in name reversed from the personal site alias (a hint: underscores in the original name make it ambiguous)
